LanguageData.Raven_Scenario_Outcast.label: [Raven] Fusang Director's Research Trip
LanguageData.Raven_Scenario_Outcast.description:
You are a low-ranking director in the Raven Fusang organization, harboring an ambition to film a bestselling adult video. You convinced a Raven Archon to carry you to a distant rimworld for research material.

The Archon sets you down gently on unfamiliar ground and flies away. You are left with only a holographic camera, two Raven notebooks, and some high-concentration aphrodisiac potion.

Use your lens to record the most primal, untamed desires across the rim!
